name: Ming circulating treasure notes
description: The Ming administration issued paper notes denominated in strings of copper coins.

impact.note: A state reissue of paper money China already knew; used across one society but it depreciated quickly and nothing later is known to rest on it.

date.basis: The British Museum states that this issue was first issued in 1375.

events.statement: The Great Ming Circulating Treasure Note was first issued.
events.scope: This dates the museum-described issue, not the invention of paper money; its nominal coin denomination does not establish market exchange value or redemption.
events.caveats: This dates the museum-described issue, not the invention of paper money; its nominal coin denomination does not establish market exchange value or redemption.
